notes.title: Undying West v0.2.0 - “Loot to Shoot!”
notes.notes: [p]This update brings numerous NPC and audio focused updates / bug fixes. NPCs are now tiny bit more challenging, and removal of starter items encourages players to loot in order to shoot. Enjoy![/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Various sound issues (attenuation, inside/outside sound filtering, network replication)[/p][/*][*][p]Robot's eyes will now turn off when they are dead[/p][/*][*][p]Boss collision geometry is now disabled when it dies[/p][/*][*][p]Revolver HUD ammo count will now display correctly for all players[/p][/*][*][p]Tripwire will now disable movement for robots[/p][/*][*][p]Robot will no longer get stuck when player dies during attack phase[/p][/*][*][p]Tonic impact sounds will now replicate to all players[/p][/*][*][p]Fire effects on NPCs will now replicate to all players[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Added:[/h2][list][*][p]Hearing sense for enemies (currently only hears gunshots)[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic HUD for items[/p][/*][*][p]Impact sounds for Revolver and Lantern[/p][/*][*][p]Menu screens![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Changed:[/h2][list][*][p]Replace zombie model with placeholder robot[/p][/*][*][p]Robots will not longer stop to play hit-react animation when getting shot[/p][/*][*][p]Robots will notice players quicker if they are closer[/p][/*][*][p]Robots now has a different "idle" speed vs "attack" speed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: v0.1.2 - "Connected" Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h1]v0.1.2 - "Connected" Patch Notes[/h1][p]v0.1.2 patch release brings numerous updates to the "Connected" build, mostly focus on bug fixes but also includes some new features as well as tweaks to existing ones. Enjoy![/p][p][/p][h2]Fixed[/h2][list][*][p]Shovel+enemy impact now replicates to clients[/p][/*][*][p]3rd player in lobby will now spawn correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamite position is now replicated properly during throw[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy collision and AI are now disabled when they die[/p][/*][*][p]Players are now blocked by enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamite exploding in player’s inventory will release its slot[/p][/*][*][p]Picking up certain items will no longer disable inputs for active item[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy health is no longer visible after it has been killed[/p][/*][*][p]Disruptor throwing no longer toggles the item on/off[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changed[/h2][list][*][p]Disruptor is now a placeable instead of a throwable object.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed friendly fire[/p][/*][*][p]Significantly decreased shovel damage[/p][/*][/list][h2]Added[/h2][list][*][p]Reload sound[/p][/*][*][p]Tonic item (health potion)[/p][/*][*][p]Player headlight (to see equipped items in the dark)[/p][/*][*][p]Boss can now be hit with shovel[/p][/*][/list][h2]Known Issues[/h2][list][*][p]Cannot rejoin lobby after leaving game or lobby. Restart game to fix[/p][/*][*][p]NPC footstep sounds doesn't always play[/p][/*][/list]
